PLAN "3-Week Reconditioning Block"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "recondition to pre-illness strength levels"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (3 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Reintroduction Lower/Push":
        warmup:
          running 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Pull/Posterior Chain":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_row 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Lower Assistance & Mobility":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progressive Loading Week 2":
        warmup:
          running 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x5 rpe 6..7 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 3x5 rpe 6..7 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Pull/Policy Reinforcement":
        warmup:
          rowing 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Friday training 50m "Lower Density Squats & Mobility":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          glute_bridge 60 seconds
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Taper & Feedback":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 4 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x5 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          bench_press 2x5 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lighter Upper Focus":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Recovery Cues & Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 2x5 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
          bent_over_row 2x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 60 seconds
  }
